The California Attorney General's Registry download of [date] lists your FEIN 84-XXXXXXX with Registry Status 'Delinquent', set 2026/07/08 — the AG's own file header states organizations on this list may not operate or solicit in California. Both links below are your own filing and the regulator's own list." candidates.regenerates: Registration is not a one-time fix — it is an ANNUAL renewal in every state, on staggered deadlines tied to each charity's fiscal year (CA RRF-1 due 4.5 months after FYE; CO, NY, FL, PA etc. each on their own clock). Miss any one and the status flips. MEASURED regeneration: 7,835 California Delinquent statuses were newly set in 2026 alone (Date Status Set field), and CA republishes the lists twice a month. A charity that cures today owes ~41 new filings within 12 months, and picks up NEW state obligations as online donations arrive from new states — so the monitored surface grows rather than shrinks. That is why the subscription never becomes moot: the customer is buying a calendar + tripwire across 41 registers, not a one-time repair.
